narrative.en:
Eight fresh V4 hook pools hit the felt in a single day, and the eye goes straight to the pattern rather than the noise. Six of them are running the same hook contract — 0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc — with identical settings across the board and a different token underneath each one. Almost every pair sits against WETH. That is not a coincidence; that is a hand shuffling from a stacked deck, one system, one operator, a web of pools spun outward from a single algorithm.

The other two play a different game: zero fee, a different hook — 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc — and one of them paired against native ETH itself. Zero fee on a hooked V4 pool means the money isn't being made at the swap window, and the house never works for free. Something else is being monetised — an oracle feed, an LP incentive design, a rebalancing strategy. The fee is the tell, or rather the absence of it.

And the date is the thirty-first of October. Halloween. Don't read too much into it, but in this casino the calendar rarely deals at random — someone chose the day. We don't yet know whose hand is on these hooks. But eight new pools, one structure, split cleanly into two families by contract, is not debris on the floor. It is somebody's plan, and it has only just begun to unfold.
narrative.zh:
江湖一夜之间多了八处新开的门户，全立在 V4 的hook之上。其中六处用的是同一套心法——0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc，规矩一模一样，门下的弟子却各不相同，且几乎都以 WETH 为伴。这不是巧合，是同一只手在落子：一个侠客以一套算法为根，向外织网，一处处接引 liquidity 如引内力入脉。

另有两处走的是另一条路：零费，另一套 hook——0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，其中一处直接以原生 ETH 为对。开池不收过路钱，说明这门派的香火不烧在换手处；江湖上没有白给的内力。或是指路之眼，或是引 LP 之法，或是再平衡之术——费率为零本身，就是话里有话。

再看日子：十月三十一日，万圣。不必多想，但江湖里的日子少有随手的，总有人特意挑了这一天。眼下还看不清这几个 hook 背后是谁的门派，可八处新池、一套结构、按契约清清楚楚分作两路——这不是地上的碎屑，是有人布的局，棋子才刚落下第一枚。

take.en: Eight new hooked pools, one repeated contract, two distinct families, and a date chosen on purpose — someone is building infrastructure, and the game has only just been dealt.
take.zh: 八处新池、一套重复的心法、两路分明，再加上一个被刻意挑中的日子——有人在内功层面筑基，棋局才刚开。

narrative.en:
Two blocks apart, two holes in the ledger, and the felt is still warm. At 26302194 the table is set with WETH and a small token answering to 0x228af — zero fee, tick spacing sixty, hooks nailed to 0x15e5e. One block earlier, 26301930, the same shape with a different hand: WETH and 0xa12cc, a ten-thousand fee, a two-hundred-tick spread, hooks at 0x444085. Two pools in two minutes. Both with the thin token as the base. Both carrying custom logic on the hooks. Somebody is not shuffling. Somebody is dealing.

Understand what a zero fee actually is. It is honey poured on the felt — the arbitrageurs come first, then the ants, and the liquidity provider is the one holding the sieve. A high fee is the opposite: a velvet rope, a filter that keeps the small money outside and lets the heavy money lean on the rail. Neither is a virtue. Both are settings. But the hooks — the hooks are the joker slipped into the deck. They can rewrite the rules of the deal while the deal is running. Restrict who enters, change how a swap behaves, reverse liquidity out from under the people who thought they were providing it.

Look at the hook addresses. Both fresh. No history, no scars, no record of anything. Nobody at this table knows what those contracts do, and that is the part that should keep you awake. When V4 was announced the word everyone used was flexibility. Flexibility is a dark room now — and nobody has found the switch. Two pools, the same zero underneath, different settings on top. One architect or two? If one, he is gathering data. If two, the race has already started and nobody fired a gun. Either way, tomorrow morning someone wakes up to find his liquidity re-coded by a hook he never met.

The deal is in motion. Cards are on the felt. I am watching.
narrative.zh:
江湖一夜之间多了两处新门派，相隔不过两息。第一处，以 WETH 与一个无名小币 0x228af 为基, 零费而立, 步幅六十, 其护法之钩悬于 0x15e5e。前一息, 又一处, 仍是 WETH, 换了 0xa12cc, 费收一万, 气脉拉开二百格, 钩在 0x444085。两息之内, 两座山门。皆以零为底, 皆自带一套外人看不懂的门规。有人不是在练功, 是在布阵。

零费者, 蜜也。蜜落于地, 先来的不是同道, 是蜂。套利者先至, 蝼蚁随之, 而真正出内力的人, 手持的是筛子。高费者反其道——门槛如铁, 把小角色挡在山外, 只留重注者凭栏。二者皆非善恶, 只是设定。可那钩……钩是袖里那张鬼牌。牌局未歇, 它可以随时改写发牌的规矩: 拦谁入门, 改换手之形, 甚至把别人灌注的内力反手抽走。

再看那两处钩的来历。皆是新铸, 无门无谱, 无过往一战可考。座上无人知晓这两门护法究竟会做什么, 这才是真正叫人夜里难眠的地方。当年 V4 初立, 众人皆言「灵活」二字。如今灵活成了一间没有灯的屋子, 而谁也没摸到开关。两处山门, 底下同一个零, 上头两套规矩。是一人所为, 还是两人对弈? 若是一人, 他在收江湖的消息; 若是两人, 那么比试已经开始, 只是没人听见锣响。无论如何, 明日清晨总会有人醒来, 发现自己灌注的内力, 已被一记从未谋面的钩重新改写过。

牌已发下。局已开。我只在看。

take.en: Two pools, two minutes, two unknown hook contracts — and the only real question at this table is not whether it is a test, but who is being tested. Flexibility without disclosure is not innovation; it is a dark room with the door locked from the inside.
take.zh: 两息之内两座山门, 两处无人识得的钩——真正的问题从来不是这是否一场试炼, 而是谁在被试。灵活而不示人, 不是开创, 是一间从里面锁了门的暗室。

narrative.en:
Someone worked the felt overnight and laid down two pools on V4 through the same hook contract — 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc — both cut at a zero fee, both set at the same spacing, both pairing native ETH against tokens that carry the look of a fresh distribution. First one styled b4981f34, second 75c88cb7. Neither has surfaced on a serious listing desk. Neither has shown its face on a centralized exchange. These are not memes with history, not projects with a site and a voice on the timeline. Just contracts somebody deployed, funded, and left standing like chips stacked at an empty seat.

The hook is the tell. One hand, twice played. That address signs under no protocol anyone recognizes — no dynamic fees, no oracles, no aggregator counting its take. An empty sleeve that lets a pool exist and asks nothing further. The house sees that shape when it wants the table occupied but doesn't care to answer questions about who's sitting there.

What sharpens it is the clock. Two deployments, an hour apart, the same shape both times. No fiddling with the parameters, no second guess on the cut, no attempt to find a different geometry. Just two different tokens, both against ETH, pressed into an identical mold by someone who had already decided. Could be a test. Could be a warm-up. Could be a man parking a pair of contracts where the market isn't looking. But two pools inside an hour, zero fee, one hook — the deck isn't dealt yet, and the cards are already on the table.
narrative.zh:
夜里有人出手，在同一条脉络上连开两池——皆由同一个钩子契约 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc 所化，抽成归零，间距一致，皆以原生以太为对手，配的是两枚看着像新发份子的代币。头一池唤作 b4981f34，第二池唤作 75c88cb7。两者都不曾在大门派的名册上留名，也不曾在中心化的山门前露过脸。不是有年头的旧物，也不是立了山门、开了号、天天在江湖上讲话的帮派。不过是有人布下的契约，灌了内力，便撒手任其悬着。

钩子是同一只手。那处地址不挂任何名门，不识什么动态抽成，不请什么 oracle，也不入什么 TVL 榜。只是一层空壳，容得下池子活着，却不愿多答一句。江湖上常见这种手法——想让一个池子存在，却不想让人追问它为何存在。

真正耐人寻味的，是时辰。两池相隔不过一个时辰，规格分毫不差。不曾试别的抽成，不曾换别的间距，也不曾想着把形状调一调。只是取了两枚不同的代币，都以以太为底，按同一个模子压下去。或许是试探，或许是起手，或许只是有人在市井睡去时，把两纸契约搁在了 V4 这块地方。可一个时辰之内、零抽成、一只手，连落两子——这就不是随手了。这是有人心里早就知道下一局怎么走，牌还没发，牌面已经摊在桌上。

take.en: The same hand built two identical pools an hour apart, and identical hands don't guess — they rehearse. The cards are on the table before the deck is even cut.
take.zh: 同一只手在同一个时辰里落下两枚一模一样的子，一模一样便不是随手——是演练。牌未发，牌面已摊在桌上。

narrative.en:
The night opens on the same hook contract again, 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc, surfacing like a card shuffled one time too many. Five pools, every one of them carrying a zero fee, every one on the same step of sixty, and in each case the chair across the felt is the native coin — with a different second token sitting down each time. Somebody is dealing one card per block and watching which one lands face up.

Then there is the other hand. 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc prefers a wider step, two hundred, and runs four pools, two of which are not native at all — token against token, no ether at the base. The fee is zero here too. Which means this table was never built to rake chips; it was built for something else. Volume, perhaps. Perhaps the shape of an order someone wants to move without being seen moving it.

Farther down the room sit two pools charging ten thousand, and those are not seats for tourists. 0x948916f1… and 0xbdef42b3… — both paired with the native coin, both on the step of two hundred, yet each behind a different hook, 0x02a319b… and 0xda9993…. Someone is buying distance, not action.

The real tell is density. Ten pools standing up inside thirteen blocks is not improvisation, it is a volley. A deck was prepared in advance and simply dealt onto the table. The question was never what these tokens are. The question is who holds the hooks — one contract running five pools, another running four. Those are not strangers who happened to sit down at the same time. The night on Ethereum was quiet, apart from the riffling.
narrative.zh:
又是夜里的以太坊。同一个钩子合约反复出手，像一副被洗得太勤的牌：五个池子，费用俱为零，步距皆是六十，且每一处都与原生之币相对而坐，另一侧则每每换一张新面孔。有人一格一格地发牌，看哪一张翻过来能立住。

另有一只手，步距二百，四个池子，其中两个已不与原生币配对，而是币对币——基底不再是内力最厚的那一个。费用仍是零。可见此处图的不是收租，而是别的东西：或是流水，或是某个不愿被人看清的落子次序。

更远处还坐着两处，费用一万，那不是新入江湖的人该坐的位置。两处皆配原生币，皆步距二百，钩子却各自不同，一为 0x02a319b…，一为 0xda9993…。有人押的是长路，不是眼前这一手。

真正耐人寻味的是密度。十三个区块之内，十个池子先后落地。这不是兴之所至的随手落子，是一次齐射——牌早就备好，只是一张张推到桌上。要紧的从来不是这些代币姓甚名谁，而是谁握着这些钩子：一个合约管五个池子，另一个管四个。江湖上没有这么多恰好同席的陌生人。以太坊这一夜本是静的，唯有洗牌之声不绝。

take.en: Nobody prepares ten pools in thirteen blocks by accident — the tokens are the noise, the hand holding every hook is the signal.
take.zh: 十三个区块里立起十个池子，绝非偶然；代币是幌子，握着全部钩子的那只手，才是真章。

narrative.en:
The deal came before the dawn, and the table shows sixteen fresh V4 pools. Not a sprint—a volley. Three hook contracts hold the line: 0x15e5e...8cc, 0x322dc...8cc, and 0xff305...ec. The first took ETH pairs at tickSpacing 60—six pools in a row, all zero fee, addresses ending *ea. The second laid four pools at tickSpacing 200 with token 0xc9eef...581 at the center. The third placed two ETH pools at tickSpacing 200.

Look at the token addresses and the pattern is a dealt hand: 0x...6ea, 0x...ea—a cluster, not a random scatter. Block timestamps run from 26280435 through 26280859, with some initializations less than a minute apart. That is a script, not a hand.

Every pool carries zero fee. On V4 that means the economics ride on hooks, not the standard fee tier. The hooks are not listeners; they are the extraction mechanism. And the spacing—60 for ETH pairs against 200 for the rest—splits liquidity strategy: tighter for active trade, wider for volatile pairs.

WETH pools (0xc02...) run through 0xff305 and 0x322dc, a different set from the ETH pairs through 0x15e5e. Different hooks, different logic—different teams, or one team with different plays. What the hooks actually do—dynamic fees, oracles, MEV protection—is not on the table. But sixteen pools in a night, all zero fee, all one coordinated deal: the deck is assembled and the cards are dealt. Now we watch who makes the first move.
narrative.zh:
天色未亮，江湖上已多了十六个V4池子。不是单骑试探，是一阵连发。三个钩子合约站在台前：0x15e5e...8cc、0x322dc...8cc、0xff305...ec。第一个接下ETH交易对，间距六十，六个池子连成一排，皆为零费，地址收在*ea。第二个布下四个池子，间距二百，0xc9eef...581在阵心。第三个只放两个ETH池，间距仍是二百。

再看代币地址，0x...6ea与0x...ea排成一线，这不是散落的暗器，是同一门派的手笔。区块时间从26280435到26280859，有些初始化相隔不足一分钟。手动布阵没有这般整齐，背后是脚本在走。

所有池子都不收标准费用。V4之中，这意味着内力不在常规费用层，而灌入钩子。钩子不是旁听者，是取值的机关。间距六十对ETH交易对，二百对其余，是两套流动性心法：一紧一松，一为快打，一为宽守。

WETH（0xc02...）的池子走0xff305与0x322dc，与走0x15e5e的ETH池并非同一路数。不同钩子，不同逻辑，或许是不同门派，或许是一派多术。钩子究竟在做什么——动态费用、预言机、MEV防护——尚未见底。但一夜十六池、全零费、步调一致，这已是布好的局。牌在桌上，且看谁先落子。

take.en: Sixteen zero-fee V4 pools in one night from three dominant hooks and a tight token-address cluster is coordinated deployment, not market signal.
take.zh: 一夜十六个零费V4池，三处钩子主导，代币地址成串，这是有组织的布阵，不是散乱的市场信号。

narrative.en:
Twenty-sixth of October, and the table is set with a house rule that costs nothing: pool after pool opens at zero, the creators taking not one satoshi. The same hook — 0x15e5e7 — deals six pools inside an hour, token addresses 0x0000, 0x04d6b9, 0xb45934 sliding across the felt, spacing fixed at sixty or two hundred. That is not a market finding its price; that is a deck being shuffled in public.

Another hook, 0x322dcec, keeps the same zero and the two-hundred spacing, working WETH against 0xc3a90d, 0x07599a, 0x7364b7 — three pools in an evening. 0xff3055 puts its chips on 0x8be5ac and 0xafb38f, same terms, same zero. Then the exception: one pool, 0x49977f, hooked through 0x784ff9, asks 12500. Somebody decided to charge the table. Why? Maybe not a meme; maybe liquidity with a pulse.

Most pairs run to the zero address — ETH — and the tokens end in 6ea, 92a, 8ea, a serial print rather than a guest list. The blocks stack seconds apart; no human hand moves that fast, or if one does, it is a metronome pressing create. Pool IDs are only hashes, but behind each is a believer or a dealer who hopes one card turns trump. Tomorrow they die or they ignite. I will watch, as always.
narrative.zh:
十月二十六日，江湖上开了一场不收过路费的局。同一个钩子 0x15e5e7 在一个时辰内连开六池，零费，刻度六十或二百；0x0000、0x04d6b9、0xb45934 这些名号像同一门派连夜递出的拜帖，不像各路侠客偶然相逢。

另一个钩子 0x322dcec 也是零费、二百刻度，拿 WETH 与 0xc3a90d、0x07599a、0x7364b7 结伴，一个晚上布下三池。0xff3055 押在 0x8be5ac 与 0xafb38f 上，规矩一样，仍是零。唯一的异数是 0x49977f，经 0x784ff9 之手，收 12500——有人偏要在免费局里摆一张收费的桌，或许不是玩笑，而是有内力的真流动性。

多数池子对着零地址，那是 ETH；代币名尾数 6ea、92a、8ea，像同一炉铸出的暗器，一串接一串。区块挨得只差几息，不像人手，像机关；池 ID 只是哈希，背后却有人信它会亮，或只是发牌，等一张成王。明日这些池子或死或燃，我依旧在看。

take.en: The day’s tell is serial zero-fee pool creation by repeat hooks, not discovery; the one paid exception is the only hand that looks like it expects real liquidity.
take.zh: 今日的江湖气不在零费本身，而在同一钩子连开六池的节奏：那是发牌，不是寻价；唯一收费的池子，是唯一像在等真内力入局的异数。

narrative.en:
The night deals itself. Fifteen pools in a single session, one initialization after another, cards sliding off a deck nobody bothered to shuffle — block 26266006 opens the hand with a D34A/F832 pair, and from there the felt just keeps filling. Four different houses are working the table, and most of them take nothing at the door: zero commission, again and again, which tells you the money is being made somewhere other than the obvious place. Mev-shaped, oracle-shaped, something else shaped. The house always collects; it just doesn't always collect at the window.

The main dealer has a face: one hook contract running ETH pairs like a machine, five pools in an hour — 0xd062, 0x8941, 0x3ca0, 0xcf97, the whole run under a single hand, all at nothing. Somebody is laying out a grid, not placing a bet. Another player takes the table with two pairs and a commission of 8388608 — not a typo, a rare suit for this game, and worth watching to see what logic justifies it. A third spreads three pools across the space of a few deals, all with a coarse two-hundred step and no rake at all: a wide net for volatile pairs. And off to the side, one pool on a non-standard token, dealt by its own rules.

Fifteen hands, four hooks, one session. The deck is full and the deal continues. I observe.
narrative.zh:
这一夜的牌局，是从第六个区块开始的。十五个池子，一手接一手地摊开，像有人不肯洗牌，只管发牌。四个不同的门派同时下场，各有各的路数。最惹眼的是那位只用一个招式、连开五池的——同一门手法，五对手牌,像是布阵，不是下注。

更有意思的是抽水的方式。大多数池子不收过路钱，一分不取。江湖上真正赚钱的地方，从来不在门口。可能在暗处，可能在别处，只有布阵的人自己清楚。另有一门，出手的筹码是八百三十八万那一路的稀罕数目，不是笔误，是极少见的招式——值得记下，看它日后如何自圆其说。还有一位侠客，短短几手之间连开三池，步子迈得极宽，专挑水深的对子下手，零抽成，广撒网。角落里另有一池，走的是不常见的路子，配的也是不常见的对手。

十五个池，四门手法，一夜之间。牌面已满，发牌未停。我看着。

take.en: Fifteen pools in one session, four separate houses, and almost every one of them taking zero at the door — the revenue is hiding off the table, and only the dealer knows where.
take.zh: 一夜十五池，四门并起，几乎个个不取过路钱——真正挣钱的地方不在台面上，只有布阵的人知道在哪里。

narrative.en:
The night dealt strange. Fourteen new V4 pools on Uniswap inside ninety minutes — and that is only the ones the scanner caught, the ones that lingered long enough on the felt to be counted. Blocks came one after another like cards off a shoe, and somewhere behind the curtain a hand was not shuffling. It was stacking.

The tell sits in the cluster: six pairs bound to a single hook, 0x0207, every one of them with a 2500 fee and a tick spacing of 1. WBTC/WETH, USDT/WETH, and two tokens whose addresses I did not trouble to memorise — all of it wired to the same hook. Six identical configurations in a row is not a deal, it is a strategy. A liquidity net with a lattice fine enough to place capital to the inch. Why that inch, I do not ask. I only note that nobody builds a lattice by accident.

Then two pools on hook 0x322d, both with zero fee and a tick spacing of 200. One carries a token with something onion-shaped in its name; the other pairs to WETH. A hook that takes nothing is either a laboratory, a way to rearrange the order of execution, or something the house has not yet named.

And last, one pool on hook 0xf583 — fee 10000, tick spacing 200, and a token whose address reads like it was minted minutes ago. Wide step, steep rake: the classic posture of a player who expects little movement and intends to collect rent while the table is looking elsewhere. No conclusions. Only what the felt showed. But if you watch V4, you already know: this was not a night of random initialisations. Someone knows precisely what they are doing. The only open question is which card they mean to play.
narrative.zh:
今夜江湖不静。九十分钟之内，十四口新池在 Uniswap 上开张——而这还只是被扫描到的那些，是那些在台面上停留得够久、被数进来的。区块一个一个过去，像发牌，而帘子后面那只手不是在洗牌,是在叠牌。

破绽在那一簇：六对池子系于同一个钩子 0x0207，费率一律 2500，刻度间距为 1。WBTC/WETH、USDT/WETH，另有两枚代币，地址我懒得去记——全都接在同一个钩子上。六次相同的布置接连出现，那不叫巧合，那叫布阵。这是一张织得极密的内力网，力道可以精确到寸。为何要精确到寸，我不问。我只记下一件事：没有人会无意间织出这样的网。

随后两口池，钩子 0x322d，费用为零，刻度间距 200。一口里那代币的名字，带着几分葱蒜气；另一口对着 WETH。不取分文的钩子，要么是试剑之地，要么是为了挪动出手的先后次序，要么是某种尚未命名的东西。

最后一口，钩子 0xf583，费率一万，刻度间距 200，而那代币的地址看着像刚刚铸成。步子宽，抽头重——这是料定风浪不大、趁众人不备收租的架势。不下断语，只叙事实。但若你也盯着 V4，你已明白：今夜不是随手开局，有人清楚自己在做什么。剩下的问题只有一个——他要打出哪一张牌。

take.en: Fourteen pools in ninety minutes, six of them one identical configuration under a single hook — that is not noise, that is a hand being dealt on purpose.
take.zh: 九十分钟十四口池，其中六口用同一套布置系在同一个钩子上——这不是杂音，是有人刻意在叠牌。

narrative.en: The felt split three ways by midnight, and none of it smelled like ordinary order flow. Six ETH/USDC pairs hit the table with spacing set to one, all inside a 39-block window—26251943 to 26251982, roughly eight minutes—and five different hook contracts, no repeats. That is not a trader testing a line; that is a conveyor belt of configurations, someone counting how many unique mechanisms can be dealt in one pass and, more quietly, why.
narrative.zh:
子夜过后，牌桌分作三处，气息都不像寻常买卖。六对 ETH/USDC 齐齐落座，间距压到一，全在 26251943 至 26251982 这三十九个区块之间，前后不过八分钟；五枚不同的钩子契约，无一重复。这不是侠客试剑，这是有人在山门外摆开流水线，问的是同一口气里能布下多少种阵，更要紧的是，他为何要问。

第二处，五座零费之池，间距二百，其中一边是个无名地址，而钩子都系在同一条契约 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc 上；三座连着零地址，也就是本门原生 ETH。这更像给同一套门规铺一张内力网——一位管路由的执事，决定哪一对先醒。

第三处，两座池子各用不同代币，却共用一条钩子 0xf6ce7756e6813f259a2b2bcb746f8cf0042fe0cc，在同一区块里开阵：WBTC 与一个无名代币，对着同一个对手。到这一步已不是试手，是照着一个接口，把不同地基接进同一座山门。

最静的一手反而最重：0xcb47459bad70cdb0319b8f9a2c3122beb8624455 与 0xfedc5f4a6c38211c1338aa411018dfaf26612c08 两枚都不在主流名册上的代币，零费，间距二百，钩子 0xc2988a37d611779ad34b561231ee33603d15a0cc。这不是供人进出的流动性，这是基础设施的一层——有人在筑节点，不是在挖池子。牌已摆好，局才刚开。

take.en: The day’s tell is infrastructure, not liquidity: hooks are being assembled as economic primitives while the market watches the felt.
take.zh: 今日最锋利的信号不在池中水位，而在山门骨架：有人已把钩子当作门规来铸，最安静的那座节点才是先手。

narrative.en:
Fourteen new V4 hook pools hit the felt — fourteen, initialized on different blocks, all keeping the same rhythm. Most ask nothing at the door: zero fee, a spacing of sixty, and the same hook contract, 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc, breathing in every second pool. ETH-WETH? No — WETH barely sits at this table. The pairs mostly run against the zero address, with tokens whose names end in "6ea," like one family, one cluster, or a dealer handing out a single suit.

Then there is the other hand: block 26244955, a partnership with WETH, spacing 200, and a different hook, 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc. This is not the same deck. A test, a strategy, or someone deciding to play larger. And at block 26244820, the fee reads 8388608. Not zero. Not standard. A statement.

Look at the pool IDs. They do not read like random hashes; they read like signatures, like tracks. Someone pressed them into blocks seconds apart. Machine? A human with a hot key? Doesn't matter. V4 is already here, and the deck is not being shuffled by hand — it is being shuffled by code. Hooks are not just smart contracts. They are side doors, chances to do what the pool rules never wrote down.

I don't know what tomorrow deals. I know that tonight someone laid the cards out quietly, without noise. Now there is nothing to do but wait for the first move.
narrative.zh:
夜色未散，江湖又起微澜。十四口新池落在不同区块，却踏着同一拍子。多数不收过路费，间距六十；同一枚 hook 合约 0x15e5e7206c661a1e881f5cd33a94eaf2328fa8cc，像同一门派的暗号，隔一口池便出现一次。与 WETH 结伴？不，WETH 几乎不露面；多数池与零地址相对，代币名字都以“6ea”收尾，像同门弟子，也像有人只发一种花色。

另一路却不同：区块 26244955，一口池与 WETH 结伴，间距二百，hook 换成 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc。这不是同一套剑法。是试招，是另立门户，还是有人准备以内力硬撼，暂且不知。区块 26244820 那口池，费用写作 8388608——不是零，也不是寻常路数。数字像碑上的记号，不是随手刻的。

池的编号也不像散乱哈希，更像暗记、脚印。有人隔着几息就把它们按进区块。是机关，还是手快，已不重要。V4 的门已经开在此处，牌局由代码洗过。Hook 不只是契约，是门规之外的缝隙，是能做池规未写之事的余地。

明日棋局未知。今夜只看见有人不声不响把牌摊在桌面，等第一手。

take.en: The tell is not the fourteen pools; it is the same hook sitting in most of them while a different hook and a non-zero fee wait off to the side like a separate stack. The deck is being shuffled by code, and the first hand has not been played.
take.zh: 真正的信号不在十四口池，而在同一枚 hook 反复落子；另一枚 hook 与一笔不寻常的费用在旁静立，像另一副牌。牌已由代码洗好，先手未出。

narrative.en:
0x322dcec... shows up at the table again, and it doesn't come alone. Six pools in a day, every one with the house's cut set to zero, every one with WETH sitting at one end. When the same hook contract keeps stamping tickSpacing 200 and no fee, that's not an experiment — that's a deal being dealt before the marks even know the game.

0x322dcec... went on a tear: ETH/BTCde... at 26237531, ETH/924885a... at 26237532, ETH/9382f4a... at 26237563, and three more before the ink dried. Eight pools in a day from one hand if you count them all. No fee. Liquidity hasn't walked in yet — the felt is set, the chairs are empty. The question isn't who made them; it's who knows what card comes next.

Other hands weren't sleeping. 0x15e5e720... opened two zero-fee pools — ETH/ed5c03b... at 26237832, ETH/988a0de... at 26237412. Both tickSpacing 60. Small step, tight range. Someone's getting ready for dense trade. And 0x21258f2... took PEPE for a spin: two pools, one on WETH at 26237408, another on 0xd82653... at 26237297, both zero fee, tickSpacing 200. PEPE going two ways — either an arbitrage setup or a shuffle with no tell.

The classics still hold a seat: ETH/983f603... with a 3000 cut, tickSpacing 200, hook 0xcbc1fe9... A bet on stability, not volume. By evening of October 21, Ethereum had 14 V4 pools on the table. Not one with a fee above zero but for a single exception. Hooks are the new back of the deck — whoever shuffles them knows where the next ace lies.
narrative.zh:
0x322dcec... 又现江湖。一日之内六池连开，皆是零费，皆以 WETH 为一端。同一枚钩子合约，tickSpacing 200，分文不取——这不是试水，这是摆宴。内力未至，池已列阵，只等风起。

此合约今日连出八池：ETH/BTCde... 于 26237531，ETH/924885a... 于 26237532，ETH/9382f4a... 于 26237563，此前还有三池。皆无手续费，内劲未注，池水空悬。问的不是谁布下的局，而是谁已知下一张牌。

另有两路侠客未歇。0x15e5e720... 开两池，ETH/ed5c03b... 于 26237832，ETH/988a0de... 于 26237412，皆零费，tickSpacing 60。步小而密，意在近身缠斗。0x21258f2... 则携 PEPE 入局：一池 WETH 于 26237408，一池 0xd82653... 于 26237297，零费，tickSpacing 200。PEPE 两面下注，或为套利，或只是洗牌。

亦有守正者：ETH/983f603... 池，费 3000，tickSpacing 200，钩子 0xcbc1fe9... 不求量，求稳。至十月廿一晚，以太坊江湖共现十四池 V4，除一池外，皆不收分文。钩子已成新门派的面具，谁执此面具，谁便知下一张牌落何处。

take.en: Eight pools from one hand, fourteen on the night, almost none asking a cut — the house is stacking the deck and waiting for the first mark to sit.
take.zh: 一纸钩子合约一日布八池，十四池中几乎全零费——这不是试水，是庄家摆好了牌局，只等第一个入座的人。

narrative.en:
The night's flip of the deck began at block 26230071, when the first hook-bearing pool was shoved into the chain. Nine initializations inside ten blocks followed—not noise, but a pattern with a tell: seven of the nine pit ETH against contracts carrying suspiciously fresh addresses. Only the USDC and USDT pools carry the familiar smell of liquidity, and even those come with hooks hanging off them.

One pool at block 26230235 cuts hardest: token 0x13be...a608 against WETH, zero fee, spacing 200, hook 0x322d...68. Zero fee paired with a wide spread is not a trading desk; it is a different game—data collection, oracle nudging, something with a purpose beyond market making. A hook is always another layer of logic, and when it is fitted to a fresh token with no liquidity, the house is not there to make markets.

Then block 26230550: a pool with a 10000 fee and spacing 200 on an ETH-token pair. A 10000 fee is either a wrapper for a specific strategy or a velvet rope to keep retail out; hook 0x2f17...d040 is plainly not a passive AMM. The deck is being shuffled fast. Someone is testing new logic on V4, using pools as a sandbox. The question is not what these pools do now, but what they will do when liquidity is poured on them. For now they are marks on cards. The one dealing them knows which hand comes next.
narrative.zh:
夜里翻牌，从块高 26230071 开始。第一只带钩的池子被插进链上，随后十个区块里九次开池，这不是风过竹林，是有人按着节拍落子。九只里有七只把 ETH 与地址尚新的合约摆在对门；只有 USDC 与 USDT 那两只还带着旧江湖的流动性气味，可钩子依旧挂在门楣上。

最刺眼的是块高 26230235 那只：代币 0x13be...a608 对 WETH，零费，间距二百，钩子 0x322d...68。零费配宽口，不像做买卖的摊位，更像设来听风、记路，或暗中拨动预言机的秤。钩子从来不是装饰，是把另一层规矩藏进池子；拿它挂在新代币、空内力的地方，便不是寻常做市。

再到块高 26230550，费用一万、间距二百的 ETH 交易对，钩子 0x2f17...d040 明摆着不是那种只被动做市的旧机关。这样的门槛，要么是某种特定招式的鞘，要么是把散客挡在门外的绳。牌桌换牌很快，有人拿 V4 当演武场，先试机关，不问今日输赢。真正的问题不是这些空池此刻做什么，而是等内力灌进去以后，它们会做什么。眼下只是牌面上的记号；发牌的人，已经知道下一手该落在哪只手上。

take.en: The tell is not the empty pools; it is the hooks. Someone is rehearsing a new economic logic on V4, and the first real liquidity will reveal which hand was being dealt.
take.zh: 空池只是记号，钩子才是落子的手。等内力一灌，谁在借 V4 试招，牌面自会说话。

narrative.en:
The deck was dealt so fast last night that I stopped counting the individual cards. Fourteen new V4 pools inside a few hours is not a sprint — it is a heartbeat that has no intention of slowing down.

Seven of them carry zero fee and a spacing of 200, spread across three different hook contracts — 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc, 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc and 0xc3774a7456c4cfe8e44d780877c9771d6562e0cc. Three hooks, one template: ETH against the long tail. Somebody is testing how liquidity behaves in real time, and they are not being shy about it. Two more sit under a single hook, 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc, and the interesting part is the shape of the thing: one binds an unknown token to WETH, the other pairs two tokens where neither is ETH. That is no longer a test. That is a grid being built.

Off to the side, one pool registers a fee of 8388608 — not a typo, a dynamic fee wired to its hook, and 0xe4345ccdb948e57a8440016f2912170e9bcce080 is clearly prepared to play by its own rules. Meanwhile on GitHub a commit lands in launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks, SHA 5033182, no description, no context, just "updated README". If you have been watching this table, you already know what lives inside commits like that: not words, but schematics.

The night itself was quiet. But quiet in crypto is only ever the pause before somebody reshuffles the deck.
narrative.zh:
昨夜发牌太快，快到我不再数单张的牌。几个时辰之内，十四口新的 V4 池子落地——这不是冲刺，是一颗不打算停下来的心跳。

其中七口，零手续费，间距二百，分落在三份不同的钩子契约之下：0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc、0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc、0xc3774a7456c4cfe8e44d780877c9771d6562e0cc。三个钩子，一副模板：ETH 对长尾。有人正在实时试探内力的走向，且毫不遮掩。另有两口同出一门，0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc——形状更有意思：一口将无名之币系于 WETH，另一口两币皆非 ETH。这已不是试招，是在布阵。

侧旁一口池子，费用记作 8388608。那不是笔误，是挂在钩子上的活费；而 0xe4345ccdb948e57a8440016f2912170e9bcce080 这一门，显然打算按自己的规矩行走江湖。GitHub 上亦有一笔提交，落在 launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks，SHA 5033182，无说明，无上下文，只写着 "updated README"。若你一路看着这张桌面，便知此类提交里藏的多半不是字，是图谱。

夜里很静。可江湖的静，从来只是有人要重新洗牌之前的停顿。

take.en: Fourteen pools in a few hours is not accumulation, it is calibration — and calibration always comes before the hand that actually matters.
take.zh: 十四口池子不是积蓄，是校准；而校准，永远发生在真正那一手之前。

narrative.en:
The night of October 18 dealt fourteen new tables on Uniswap V4, all opened inside a narrow window of a couple thousand blocks — and more than half of them posted no rake at all. That is not a coincidence, that is a pattern. The hook contracts have taken the fee into their own hands, which means the standard mechanism for paying liquidity is switched off at the felt. Something else is running the economics — dynamic, external, or simply elsewhere.

Two hooks stand out. 0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 sits behind three pools priced at 12500 — one hundred twenty-five hundredths of a percent — while 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc holds two pools at zero. Same hand, clearly. A third active hook, 0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc, carries three zero-fee pools, every one of them pairing WETH against tokens that do not announce themselves.

And here is the tell: a zero-fee pool is not built for arbitrage. It is built for capturing order flow outright, or for trading that prefers to stay out of sight while the yield is swept up into the hook's own contract. Where the pool charges nothing, the profit moves to the layer of execution — and whoever holds the hook holds the game. A handful of pools pair ETH with tokens that appear on no public listing — 0x845eaf..., 0x07faa4..., 0xc5055b... — the shape of test distributions or private placements. Someone is laying the table before the announcement. First the pool, then the noise.

Fourteen tables dressed, chips placed, dealers at their stations. Now we wait to see who sits down.
narrative.zh:
十月十八这一夜，Uniswap V4 上又开出十四张新桌，前后不过数千个区块的功夫。怪的是，半数以上的桌子不收抽成。这不是偶然，是路数。hook 合约把费率之权收归己手，池子层面那道抽水的机关便等于废了——真正的账，另有一处算。

其中两个 hook 最惹眼：0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 掌着三池，费率一百二十五百分之一；0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 掌着两池，分文不取。出手的显然是同一个人。另有一路 hook——0xa6cc4ffa9ebaefd8ab7d3d018b0ae31ec5b760cc——三池皆零费，且都以 WETH 对着一批来历不明的token。

江湖上都懂：零费之池，不为套利而设。要么是抢单流，要么是暗中过手，把内力尽数导进 hook 自家的经脉里。池面不收，收益便全落在执行那一层——谁握着 hook，谁就握着这局棋的手筋。另有一二池，以 ETH 配着从未见于公开名册的 token——0x845eaf...、0x07faa4...、0xc5055b...——像是试招，也像是私下分派。有人先立山门，再放风声；先有池，后有喧嚣，历来如此。

十四张桌已摆好，灯也点上，庄家各就各位。剩下的，只看谁先落座。

take.en: When more than half the new tables charge no rake, the money is not gone — it has simply moved to whoever owns the hook, and that is the only seat worth watching.
take.zh: 半数新池不收抽成，钱并未消失，只是从池面转到了握 hook 的那只手上——这一手，才是真正该看的位置。
